AppleとOpenAIのモデルに基づいて構築されたAIアシスタントがKeynote・Pages・NumbersだけでなくLogic Proにも追加、Keynote・Pages・NumbersはMCPをサポート
AI assistants built on Apple and OpenAI models have been added not only to Keynote Pages Numbers but also to Logic Pro, and Keynote Pages Numbers supports MCP
